identification: Two boxes of Art and Australia (Ure Smith, later Fine Arts Press), quarterly journal from Vol 1 No 1 May 1963. Titles read from spines: Vol 1 No 1 (May 1963), Vol 1 No 2 (Aug 1963), Vol 3 No 1 (Jun 1965), Vol 4 No 4 (Mar 1967), Vol 6 No 1 (Jun 1968), Vol 7 No 3 (Dec 1969), Vol 16 No 2 (Dec 1978). The rest are unreadable stacked edges, and a later large-format ART and Australia issue sits on top. Single issues are common; the whole run is also free online at artandaustralia.com/archive.

viewing_check: Check the run for gaps and count of issues (a complete Vol 1 to 4 with 1963 issues is the main value). Check Vol 1 No 1 cover and spine for tears, loose pages or staining, and look for any special issues or Fine Arts Press folded supplements. Condition of the 1960s issues matters more than the later ones.
